summary: NexPoint Capital filed an 8-K solely to disclose the NAV per share ($4.45) as of May 31, 2026, and the price at which shares are issued under its distribution reinvestment plan (DRP). The filing contains no transaction, no tender offer, no merger, no spin-off, no activist campaign, no strategic review, no delisting, no liquidation, and no management change. It is a routine regulatory update regarding valuation policies under Rule 2a-5. There are no deal terms, no board recommendation, no advisor, and no risk-arb angle. This is a standard periodic disclosure for a BDC, not a special situation.
